subject.title: fix(clickclack): name discussion channels from session titles

question: Should this cross-repository ClickClack display-title contract be accepted after a maintainer reviews real server proof for both creation and reconciliation?
rationale: The branch changes an external service contract and carries a protected maintainer label; test doubles establish intended client behavior but cannot confirm deployed server compatibility or workspace migration behavior.

options.title: Request live ClickClack proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted create-and-reconcile transcript or recording from a real compatible ClickClack workspace, including an existing hash-named channel.

options.title: Accept contract risk
options.body: Merge based on the focused tests and companion-server claim while accepting that deployed version-skew behavior was not independently demonstrated.

options.title: Pause for server-contract confirmation
options.body: Hold the PR until the ClickClack server change and its compatibility guarantees are explicitly confirmed by an owner.

recommendation.title: Request live ClickClack proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted create-and-reconcile transcript or recording from a real compatible ClickClack workspace, including an existing hash-named channel.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor spanning the linked naming proposal, this plugin PR, and the stated companion server work.
